# pangolin_logs_analytics (Data Source)

Returns the request analytics rollup of the configured organization - same view the Pangolin web UI displays under "Logs > Analytics". Three breakdowns: by country, by day, and global totals.

> **Note:** Requires an active enterprise subscription on Pangolin Cloud. Always available on self-hosted enterprise installs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull the analytics rollup for the default 7-day window.
data "pangolin_logs_analytics" "weekly" {}

output "weekly_total" {
  value = data.pangolin_logs_analytics.weekly.total_requests
}

output "weekly_blocked" {
  value = data.pangolin_logs_analytics.weekly.total_blocked
}

# Top 5 countries by request volume.
output "top_countries" {
  value = slice(data.pangolin_logs_analytics.weekly.requests_per_country, 0, 5)
}

# Narrow to a single resource over a custom range.
data "pangolin_logs_analytics" "app_monthly" {
  resource_id = tostring(pangolin_resource.app.id)
  time_start  = timeadd(timestamp(), "-720h")
}

output "app_blocked_share" {
  value = (
    data.pangolin_logs_analytics.app_monthly.total_requests == 0
    ? 0
    : data.pangolin_logs_analytics.app_monthly.total_blocked /
      data.pangolin_logs_analytics.app_monthly.total_requests
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resource_id` (String) Narrow the analytics to a single resource (numeric ID, encoded as string for the API).
- `time_end` (String) End of the time range as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Defaults to the current time when omitted.
- `time_start` (String) Start of the time range as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days ago when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `requests_per_country` (Attributes List) Request count broken down by ISO-3166 country code resolved from the client IP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests_per_country))
- `requests_per_day` (Attributes List) Request count broken down by day, with allowed / blocked / total triplets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requests_per_day))
- `total_blocked` (Number) Total number of blocked (denied) requests over the queried range.
- `total_requests` (Number) Total number of requests over the queried range (allowed + blocked).

<a id="nestedatt--requests_per_country"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests_per_country`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code (e.g. `FR`).
- `count` (Number) Number of requests originating from this country.


<a id="nestedatt--requests_per_day"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requests_per_day`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_count` (Number) Allowed requests on this day.
- `blocked_count` (Number) Blocked requests on this day.
- `day` (String) Day bucket (server-local time, e.g. `2026-05-18 00:00:00+00`).
- `total_count` (Number) Total requests on this day.
